experiment: Experiment C: Existing OUC-CGE Pilot Audit
dataset: OUC-CGE (Ocean University of China Classroom Group Engagement)

session_leakage_audit.description: The 21 dynamic clips stem from only TWO physical classroom recordings: Session 1 (High engagement, views 1-12) and Session 2 (Low engagement, views 1-12). All high-engagement clips share the exact same room, lighting, instructor, and student cohort at the same time. Cross-validation across views inside the same session evaluates multi-camera angle consistency, NOT unseen-classroom generalization.
session_leakage_audit.individual_ground_truth_note: OUC-CGE provides ZERO individual student ground-truth attention annotations. Mapping group engagement (High/Low) to individual student tracks (1 to 6,298) is scientifically invalid.
